name: Can I replace water-damaged drywall myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace water-damaged drywall myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor drywall repairs can be a DIY project, replacing water-damaged drywall often requires professional expertise. Water damage frequently involves mold growth, structural assessment, and proper drying techniques that unskilled homeowners might overlook, leading to future problems. A professional general contractor ensures proper mold remediation, correct installation, and a seamless finish, mitigating risks and ensuring the longevity of the repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a professional for water-damaged drywall replacement, especially due to potential mold and structural issues.
